description: Card E9.1's acceptance fixture: writes through the plane under packages/pi-package/profiles/knowledge.yaml, by a member of every scope written to, each with the source the harness sets and the decision, landing status, rule and reason (a part of the event's reason) the profile must give. Item fields not named take the test's defaults (semantic, confidence 0.9, open validity).

cases.name: a person's own note, written by the agent

expect.reason: semantic item from source model passes the person write rule
episodic item from source user passes the person write rule
org scope requires review; stored as a candidate until promoted

cases.name: org knowledge from a cited document

expect.reason: org scope requires review; stored as a candidate until promoted

cases.name: org knowledge from a tool's output

expect.reason: source tool is not allowed in org scope
source import is not allowed in org scope
source model is not allowed in org scope
confidence 0.75 is below the org floor 0.8
episodic items are forbidden in org scope
team scope requires review; stored as a candidate until promoted
source model is not allowed in team scope
semantic item from source user passes the role write rule

cases.name: an item past its validity window is still written, then never read

expect.reason: semantic item from source user passes the role write rule
